eyebrow: Momcozy · NYC OCT 2026 home shoot · Jordana & Gabe, Bedminster · Air purifier vlog
title: Jordana:
headline: Jordana puts a new filter in her Momcozy air purifier, comes back 30 days later, and holds the old one next to a fresh one: it is literally a different color, and that is the air around her kids.
story: A simple test vlog. Jordana says she has had her Momcozy purifier for a while and starts a little test with a new filter. Then time passes (new outfit, new room). She liked it so much she got a second one for her other child's room, so she has a fresh filter to hold next to her 30-day-old one.

The reveal is the whole video: blue new filter next to the grey used one. Her reaction is real: “That is a lot of dust. It's literally a different color.” She ends on peace of mind about the air around her baby, over her kids playing.

Loops: L1 “What does a used filter look like?” opens at 0:00 (we flash the two filters) and closes at 0:30 (the reveal). L2 “Does it make a difference?” opens at 0:03 and closes at 0:34 (“a huge difference”). Stakes: the air her kids breathe.
do: Open on the two filters side by side with the hook text already on screen at 0:00.
Show the filter going in with quick cuts (IMG_9435).
Use the outfit change as the time jump. A small “30 days later” label.
Make the reveal land: hold the two filters 2 s, then her reaction.
Show the kids in the room near the end so a baby is on camera.
dont: No logo, no name card, no fade at 0:00.
No unboxing look. Skip “Here's a brand new air purifier”; start at “I'm going to put this new filter inside”.
No director voice or “and action” slates.
Do not say or show “eight hours”. She says 30 days and a month.

Machine transcript in the Transcript tab of this page. Check each bite by ear.
Inter font. Momcozy colors only: Cozy Chestnut #6A2B3A, Rose Pink #B27A7E, Blush #FCE4E2, Warm Cream #FEF9F6.
tech: iPhone, vertical, HEVC 3840×2160 with rotation (plays 2160×3840), about 24 fps, AAC stereo. Camera mic only.
1080×1920 at 24 fps. Source is 24 fps, no conform needed.
Clips are already vertical 9:16. No crop. Small push-ins are fine; 4K source gives room.
-14 LUFS integrated, -1 dBTP peak. Music always under her voice.
Burned in, Inter, white with a soft shadow, low in the frame, one line at a time. Easy to read over the footage (this client's most common note).
H.264 MP4, 1080×1920, 9:16. Upload to Frame.io → Ready for Review.
One camera track. Match levels between the two rooms. Cut every “and action” and off-camera voice.
Day 1 room is cooler, day 30 room warmer. Match skin tones, keep the filter colors true (blue new, grey used).
checklist: Frame 1 is the two filters with the hook text already on screen. No logo, name or fade.
No unboxing. The “brand new air purifier” words are cut.
No slates, no “and action”, no director voice.
The time jump says 30 days. Nothing says eight hours.
The side-by-side is held long enough to see the color change.
A baby or child is on camera before the end card.
Captions are Inter, white with a soft shadow. Momcozy is one word.

decisions.t: Script says eight hours, footage says 30 days
decisions.b: The script reads “[1 month later]” then “eight hours later”. Jordana says 30 days and a month on camera. The plan uses 30 days. Atdhe confirms.

decisions.t: Baby with the purifier not filmed
decisions.b: The script wants the baby on camera benefiting from it. No shot has a child next to the running purifier. The plan uses kids playing in a bedroom from General BRoll. Atdhe decides if that is enough for Peter.
“I usually move it around”, “bedroom at night, living room in the day” and “It runs really quietly” were not found in the footage, so they are not in the cut.

client_note: Why this matters: the client wants it to feel like a purifier she already uses and likes, not an unboxing, with a real result she can show.
